title:
Sometimes people only see the finished meal, not the early mornings, recipe testing, fresh ingredients, or the care that goes into every portion.

Every meal I make is cooked from scratch, made with passion, and created to be something I’d happily serve to my own family. Good food isn’t just about hitting your macros—it’s about flavour, quality, and consistency too.

That’s the standard I hold myself to every single week. ☕❤️

#MealPrep #CookedFromScratch #healthyeating
